about: A lightweight app for personal notes and checklists, stored as plain files.

prs.title: Checklist items with a | keep all their text
prs.broken: A checklist item with a | in it, like "Alpha | beta", showed only the first part, and the rest was deleted the next time the list was saved.
prs.changed: The app now reads the item text and its hidden details in the right order.
prs.matters: People no longer lose part of their notes just for using a | character.

prs.title: Checklist items checked with a capital X load as done
prs.broken: An item checked with a capital X, as GitHub and Obsidian write it, loaded as unchecked, and the next save doubled its checkbox.
prs.changed: Both parsers now accept a capital X as checked.
prs.matters: Checklists made in other editors keep their checked items.

prs.title: Sub-items indented with 4 spaces or tabs are kept
prs.broken: Checklist sub-items indented with 4 spaces or a tab were flattened or dropped, and the next save erased them from the file.
prs.changed: Each item's level now comes from its indent compared with the lines above it.
prs.matters: Nested checklists from other editors survive a save.
